name: aquaverse
description: AquaVerse — Interactive Aquarium Builder & Fish Lifecycle Simulator

scripts.check: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');function walk(d){let r=[];for(let f of fs.readdirSync(d)){let p=path.join(d,f);if(fs.statSync(p).isDirectory())r.push(...walk(p));else if(p.endsWith('.js'))r.push(p);}return r;}const files=walk('js');for(const f of files){try{const c=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');if(!c.includes('import ')&&!c.includes('export ')){new Function(c);}}catch(e){console.error('Syntax error in '+f+': '+e.message);process.exit(1);}}console.log('✓ All '+files.length+' JS files passed AST syntax check.');"
